clean: Dear Mr. Casilanos, I'm writing on behalf of the four pharmacies in the Westbrook group to raise a concern about delivery times. Over the past six weeks, our morning deliveries have arrived after 11 a.m. on more than half of all days, against a contracted window of before 9. This has a real impact on patients, because prescriptions that are waiting on stock can't be collected until the afternoon, and several of our patients travel in from rural areas by bus. We've raised this with the depot on several occasions, most recently with Ludwig on the 3rd of October, but haven't seen any improvements. We'd be grateful if you could look into the routing for our area and let us know what can be done. We've attached a log of delivery times from all four branches. If the situation doesn't improve by the end of the month, we'll need to review our arrangements. Yours sincerely, Barnaby Chunderin, Operations Lead

clean: Daily log, Tuesday. Crew of four on site at the dairy farm job, Anselm and the two apprentices. We finished mounting the rails onto the main barn roof by 11 and started placing panels after lunch. Got through 38 of the 64 panels before the wind picked up around 3 and we had to stop, gusts were over 30 miles an hour according to the app. No injuries, no damage. One issue, the barn roof has more corrosion on the purlins at the east end than the survey showed, I'd say three of them need reinforcing before we put weight on them. I've taken photos and flagged it to the engineer. The farmer was fine with us leaving equipment in the machine shed overnight. Plan for tomorrow is finish the panels if the wind drops, otherwise start the trenching for the cable run to the house.
